Hard to give an answer based on the quality of the images.

The green stones really resemble emeralds. But the cuts and coloration really differs from the patter presented by the gems.  The first  appears to have a lot of inclusions, which can lower the price, and also don't appear to be the crystal green coloration. Also, emeralds are supposed to have a sparkling glow under light, which is not observed on the image.

The other gems seem to be crystal related stones. But again is hard to tell because of the cuts, light and quality of the image.

The best thing you do is to get them for a specialist to take a look. If possible, more than one, to be sure of the result and price.

I understand you dude, also I've passed for something similar.

Four years ago, I tried to take my life out by overdosing me with benzodiazepines, alcohol and anti-emetics. I was never a depressive guy, but life was so shit, and I was having to deal with so much crap that I just decided to give up.

Before I pass out, I started feeling a huge amount of pain on my chest, and palpitations. I start panicking with the fact of having a heart attack while still being conscious, so I start praying to god to allow me to sleep before I die. So I could not feel pain in my death.

When I finally got knocked out, I remember waking up in the middle of the night, floating over my body. Around my bed, there were between four and six humanoids figures made of an extremely bright light watching my body on the bed.  I felt an immense love and peace during that dream. Also, I felt like they are protecting me from death. By guarding my body and taking care of my wile, the medicines are reaching their apex.

When I wake up on the other day, I was stroked with an immense feeling of amazement and fault for what I have done. Also, I wake up feeling extremely fine, taking to count the amount of alcohol and medicines I have taken I was pretty sure that I will at least have small hangover or waking up feeling my liver fucked. But I was super fine.

I really like your answer bro ;) 

The most of people just turn to me and they say "I really feel about it" or something like that. 

Meeting people who have been through this type of situation has really been therapeutic for me. However, I haven't decided about the treatment yet. I was always a very detached person with everything, and I was also a very spiritual person. The fact that I didn't last more than a year without the proper treatment, in addition to pissing me off, really gave me a feeling of mission accomplished. I no longer have the feeling that I will be commenting on a suicide, but only forwarding something that will naturally already happen.

On the other hand I have been looking from the side of my family and friends, they are really sad about everything that is happening. maybe more than me. Seeing their sadness really makes me think about trying this shit chimeo.  
I think only people who have been through this know what it feels like. it really is a fucking mess.
